liveScenarios.requirements: Use the actual authorized Windows Direct Sync replica. Prove no automatic generation before configuration/index and initial download settle; then prove rolling generation, explicit Generate/user Undo, current-input typed repair after restart, external child deletion and new Sync data retriggering discovery, no self-upload loop, and account/profile change during an awaited plan stopping later writes while retaining admitted actions. Local E2E does not fake this barrier.

Unlocked interactive Windows 11 x64 host; packaged candidate; normal 1Password-approved real sign-in; unused synthetic remote slot. Prove sign-in/MFA, vault discovery, initial download, secure credential separation and account/vault reauthorization without touching existing vaults.

The authorized synthetic remote vault plus an independent official Obsidian client. Prove create/edit/complete/delete in both directions, offline local edit and process restart, reconnect/upload exactly once, preserved binary/unknown metadata, and no old-account late publish.

Two independently edited synthetic replicas. Prove an actual concurrent Sync conflict retains both bytes through restart, then exercise explicit Keep local and Keep remote decisions; never synthesize a fake account or remote.
